tool_signatures.description: Analyze patterns and relationships across multiple alerts by aggregating their event data into time-based groups.

tool_signatures.name: get_alert_events
tool_signatures.description: Get events for a specific Panther alert.

tool_signatures.name: get_bytes_processed_metrics
tool_signatures.description: Retrieves data ingestion metrics showing total bytes processed per log type and source, helping analyze data volume patterns.

tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a Panther data model, including the mappings and body

tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information for specific log type schemas, including their full specifications.

tool_signatures.name: get_permissions
tool_signatures.description: Get the current user's permissions. Use this to diagnose permission errors and determine if a new API token is needed.

tool_signatures.name: get_role
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a Panther role by ID

tool_signatures.name: get_rule_alert_metrics
tool_signatures.description: Gets alert metrics grouped by detection rule for ALL alert types, including alerts, detection errors, and system errors within a given time period. Use this tool to identify hot spots in alerts and use list_alerts for specific alert details.

tool_signatures.name: get_scheduled_query
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific scheduled query by ID.

tool_signatures.name: get_severity_alert_metrics
tool_signatures.description: Gets alert metrics grouped by severity for rule and policy alert types within a given time period. Use this tool to identify hot spots in your alerts, and use the list_alerts tool for specific details. Keep in mind that these metrics combine errors and alerts, so there may be inconsistencies from what list_alerts returns.

tool_signatures.name: get_table_schema
tool_signatures.description: Get column details for a specific data lake table.

tool_signatures.name: get_user
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a Panther user by ID

tool_signatures.name: list_alert_comments
tool_signatures.description: Get all comments for a specific Panther alert.

tool_signatures.name: list_alerts
tool_signatures.description: List alerts from Panther with comprehensive filtering options

tool_signatures.name: list_data_models
tool_signatures.description: List all data models from your Panther instance. Data models are used only in Panther's Python rules to map log type schema fields to a unified data model. They may also contain custom mappings for fields that are not part of the log type schema.

tool_signatures.name: list_database_tables
tool_signatures.description: List all available tables in a Panther Database.

tool_signatures.name: list_databases
tool_signatures.description: List all available datalake databases in Panther.

tool_signatures.name: list_detections
tool_signatures.description: List detections from your Panther instance with support for multiple detection types and filtering.

tool_signatures.name: list_global_helpers
tool_signatures.description: List all global helpers from your Panther instance. Global helpers are shared Python functions that can be used across multiple rules, policies, and other detections.

tool_signatures.name: list_log_sources
tool_signatures.description: List log sources from Panther with optional filters.

tool_signatures.name: list_log_type_schemas
tool_signatures.description: List all available log type schemas in Panther. Schemas are transformation instructions that convert raw audit logs

tool_signatures.name: list_roles
tool_signatures.description: List all roles from your Panther instance.

tool_signatures.name: list_scheduled_queries
tool_signatures.description: List all scheduled queries from your Panther instance.

tool_signatures.name: list_users
tool_signatures.description: List all Panther user accounts.

tool_signatures.description: Query Panther's security data lake using SQL for log analysis and threat hunting.

tool_signatures.description: Start an AI-powered triage analysis for a Panther alert with intelligent insights and recommendations.
